en.joke: I asked AI to write me a joke about dating apps. It responded with "Have you tried turning it off and on again?"
en.explanation: It's funny because it's a deadpan jab at both dating app frustration and the generic, unhelpful nature of early AI interactions.

zh.joke: 我的会议日程是这样的：周一，为上周没完成的工作开会；周三，为这周开会耽误的工作开会；周五，为下周要开的会做准备会。

people.name: Albert Spalding
people.extract: Albert Goodwill Spalding was an American pitcher, manager, and executive in the early years of professional baseball, and the co-founder of the Spalding sporting goods company. He was born and raised in Byron, Illinois, and graduated from Rockford Central High School in Rockford, Illinois. He played major league baseball from 1871 to 1878. Spalding set a trend when he started wearing a baseball glove.
highlights: American pitcher, manager, and executive in baseball.
Co-founder of Spalding sporting goods company.
Set trend by wearing a baseball glove.

people.name: Zedd
people.extract: Anton Zaslavski, known professionally as Zedd, is a German record producer and DJ. His stage name was derived from zed, the English pronunciation for the letter Z, the first letter of his surname. Raised in Kaiserslautern, Zedd rose to mainstream success with his 2012 single "Clarity", which peaked at number eight on the Billboard Hot 100 and won Best Dance Recording at the 56th Grammy Awards. It served as the third single for his debut studio album of the same name (2012), of which its deluxe edition spawned the US top 20 single "Stay the Night".
highlights: 'Clarity' won Best Dance Recording at Grammy Awards.

people.name: Lucretia Peabody Hale
people.extract: Lucretia Peabody Hale was an American writer and editor, best known for her humorous The Peterkin Papers stories.
highlights: Best known for The Peterkin Papers stories.
